name: Imarhan
description: Tuareg desert blues band Imarhan brings the sound of the Sahara to Berlin's Gretchen. Emerging from Tamanrasset in southern Algeria, Imarhan carries the legacy of Tinariwen and Mdou Moctar—music forged in exile, resistance, and the vast expanse of the desert. Their hypnotic guitar riffs and call-and-response vocals speak to the nomadic experience, political displacement, and the tension between tradition and modernity. This is music that travels, that carries stories across borders, making it a powerful counterpoint to Europe's hardening frontiers.
